messages.subject: hr tag
parts:
Hello All,

I was looking to add a hr tag in my ui.R.
The hr tag is not an available tag but is a nice way to break information.
Writing a little help section panel for our shiny project.

Please add the hr tag going forward if you see fit.

I accomplished the insertion of an hr tag by adding the following in my ui.R.

tags$hr(),

John

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: hr tag
parts:
All HTML tags are defined as tags$p(), tags$div(), tags$hr(), etc. Many of common HTML tags are also accesible just by name, such as:
  p()
  div()
  h1()
and so on.

Many other tags aren't exported to be used without `tags$`. This is in part to avoid using up variable/function names (there are a lot of possible HTML tags) and in part to avoid overlapping with existing object names. For example, title() is a function in the base graphics package, and so if Shiny exposed tags$title() as title(), it would create a naming conflict.

If you want to write a lot of HTML, you can use the withTags function - inside of it, everything that can be used as an HTML tag will be. For example, these are equivalent:
  withTags(
    p("text"),
    hr(),
    p("more text")
  )

  # Same effect as:
  tags$p("text"),
  tags$hr(),
  tags$p("more text")


-Winston

Just to add to this, I use HTML() which takes plain ol' HTML:

o <- HTML("<p>Hello World</p>")

cat(as.character(o))

-Sarven

cat(format(x))
